neighbours.label: A suffix piece after a rarer split stem ('ated' in elucidated, 'able' in discernable, 'ment' in discernment, Russian 'ующ'); common words in the same frames stay quiet. A broad, weak pole
fire: The theory was elucidated in chapter two.
His elongated shadow crossed the street.
There is no discernable trend here.
She showed great discernment in art.
They delineated the border last year.
He is truly indefatigable at work.
quiet: The theory was given in chapter two.
His long shadow crossed the street.
There is no clear trend here.
She showed great skill in art.
They moved the border last year.
He is truly kind at work.

short: suffix after a rare split stem
